BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS version int;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF to_regclass('public.tech_version') IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE course_version cv
        SET version = CASE
            WHEN tv.version ~ '^\d+$' THEN tv.version::int
            ELSE 1
        END
        FROM tech_version tv
        WHERE cv.tech_version_id = tv.id
          AND cv.version IS NULL;
    END IF;
END $$;

UPDATE course_version
SET version = 1
WHERE version IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_version ALTER COLUMN version SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE course_version DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_course_version_tech_version;
ALTER TABLE course_version DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tech_version_id;

ALTER TABLE course_version ADD CONSTRAINT course_version_course_id_version_key UNIQUE (course_id, version);

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tech_version;

COMMIT;
